# recon-engine
> Ultra-fast Open-Source Statement Parser & Financial Reconciliation Engine in Bun.

## Core Capabilities
- Parsers: CAMT.053 (ISO 20022 XML with namespace support & reversal tracking), SWIFT MT940 (with SWIFT envelope unwrapping), Revolut CSV, Stripe CSV, Generic CSV with BOM stripping.
- Error Resilience: Batch quarantine of corrupted rows into `rejectedRows` while parsing valid rows.
- Matcher: 3-Stage O(N + M) Bucketed Matching (Exact Ref Map -> Currency/Amount Buckets -> Token-Pruned Fuzzy & Wire Fee Tolerance + Partial Payment Tracking).
- Lifecycle Filtering: Invoices filtered strictly to `status === 'OPEN'`; non-open invoices quarantined into `skippedInvoices`.
- Precision: Zero floating-point arithmetic. All money handled in integer minor units (cents). Multi-currency `totalsByCurrency`.

## CLI Invocation for Agents
- Always use headless non-interactive mode:
  bunx @danyayen/recon-engine match --statement <file> --invoices <file> --json --yes
- Parse statement to stdout JSON:
  bunx @danyayen/recon-engine parse <file> --json

## Schema Specifications
- Full specs and agent execution protocols available in AGENT.md
